question: The selling price of 20 books is equal to the cost price of 5 books. Find the loss or gain percentage.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given, SP of 20 books = CP of 5 books

⇒ 20 × SP = 5 × CP

⇒ SP ÷ CP = 1 ÷ 4

Loss = CP − SP = 4 − 1 = 3 units

Loss % = (3 ÷ 4) × 100 = 75%

**∴ The correct answer is 75% loss.**
